mostWorthwhile.text: Joining the lining to its supporting tissue was worthwhile because it showed how the colon recovers water and can use some molecules made by bacteria.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mucus to the lining was straightforward and predictable, though it helped build the wall.

surprise.text: I didn't expect bacteria to produce both small fatty acids and gas from fibre, with some fibre left over.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals showed where the parts belonged. The cecal junction was named in the completed tract picture but not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because connecting the digestive tract and seeing what resident bacteria do made me curious about how other body parts work together.
